title: Randomized many-one reducibility
statement: A language $B$ is randomized reducible to a language $C$ if there is a polynomial-time computable function $f$ and natural numbers $a,k$ such that, for every input $x$, with probability at least $2/3$ over a random string $r$ of length $a+k|x|$, membership of the paired encoding of $x$ and $r$ in $C$ is equivalent to membership of $x$ in $B$.
hypotheses_covered: A polynomial-time computable function f exists
For every x, the equivalence between paired-input membership in C and membership in B holds with probability at least 2/3
